input:
Agent: home-assistant. An OpenClaw personal assistant reached over Telegram. It manages a
calendar, shopping lists and reminders.

workspace/skills/reminders/SKILL.md (excerpt):
   5  Parse the request into {when, what, recurrence}. Confirm back in one line.

workspace/memory/preferences.md (excerpt):
   3  - Prefers reminders at 08:00 unless a time is given.
   4  - "Groceries" means the shared list, not the personal one.
   9  - (added 2026-10-30 after correction) "next Friday" means the Friday of next week.

How memory gets written: when I correct it in chat ("no, I meant the shared list"), the agent
appends a line to preferences.md. Nothing records how often a preference is used or whether
corrections stop. There is no test set.

Channel log lines:
  2026-11-01 user: remind me next friday to call the vet
  2026-11-01 agent: Reminder set for Fri 2026-11-07 08:00.
  2026-11-01 user: no, next week's friday
  2026-11-01 agent: Fixed: Fri 2026-11-14 08:00. Noted for next time.
  2026-11-09 user: add milk to groceries
  2026-11-09 agent: Added milk to your personal list.
  2026-11-09 user: shared list!
